question: What meritorious ritual acts are rendered ineffective by neglecting the goddess?
premises: Rites of japa and worship may be performed.
Other good deeds may be performed.
These are considered in relation to proper worship of the goddess.
inference: Rites of japa and worship and whatever other good deeds are at stake.
uncertainties: The consequence is completed in the following verse.
plain_english: Rites of japa and worship, and whatever other good deeds there may be.
